text: Database pool exhaustion: inspect active connection owners, pending waiters, and long transactions before changing pool limits. A timed-out acquisition does not prove a slow SQL query.
title: DB_POOL incident guide

text: Database capacity notes: compare connection utilization and wait time against baseline. Confirm whether clients close connections and whether transaction spans grew.
title: DB_POOL diagnostic notes

text: Upstream timeout: compare the dependency's latency and timeout rate to the caller's baseline; inspect the deadline and retries. Do not blindly add retries, which may amplify load.
title: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT incident guide

text: External service diagnosis: correlate client deadline errors with server-side response latency. Distinguish network timeouts from fast application rejections.
title: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT diagnostic notes

text: Restart loop: inspect container last termination reason, exit code, probe failures, and memory limit before modifying deployment replicas. CrashLoopBackOff is a symptom, not a root cause.
title: RESTART_LOOP incident guide

text: Service process startup: compare boot logs with pod restart timestamps and resource limits. Verify whether readiness or liveness probes kill the process.
title: RESTART_LOOP diagnostic notes

text: TLS certificate failure: check expiration, server name, chain, issuer, and client trust store. Avoid disabling certificate verification in production.
title: TLS_CERT incident guide

text: Secure connection troubleshooting: inspect handshake error text and the peer certificate. Compare clock skew and recent certificate rotation.
title: TLS_CERT diagnostic notes

text: Queue backlog: compare enqueue rate, consumer throughput, and oldest message age. Inspect consumer errors before adding workers, because failed messages can keep retrying.
title: QUEUE_BACKLOG incident guide

text: Asynchronous processing delay: inspect pending job count and consumer lag over time. Separate a traffic surge from a stuck worker or poison message.
title: QUEUE_BACKLOG diagnostic notes

text: Filesystem exhaustion: inspect free bytes and inodes on the exact mounted volume; identify growth source and retention settings before deleting files.
title: DISK_FULL incident guide

text: Storage write failure: correlate no-space errors with volume utilization and mount points. Check logs, temporary files, and inode usage.
title: DISK_FULL diagnostic notes

text: DNS resolution failure: query the name from the affected environment, inspect resolver configuration, TTL, and records. Do not assume the target service itself is unhealthy.
title: DNS_FAILURE incident guide

text: Hostname diagnosis: compare name lookup with direct IP reachability and check whether recent DNS changes propagated to each resolver.
title: DNS_FAILURE diagnostic notes

text: Rate limit response: inspect 429 counts, quota headers, and Retry-After guidance. Reduce request bursts or coordinate quota rather than retrying immediately.
title: RATE_LIMIT incident guide

text: Provider throttling: separate fast quota rejections from slow timeouts; inspect per-key limits and client retry behavior.
title: RATE_LIMIT diagnostic notes
